initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a fault in the upstream provenance ranking. The criteria require deterministic demand-descending provenance order, but job_1 assigns evidence ranks in ascending demand_score order, causing low-demand record n06-r08 to receive rank 1 and high-demand record n06-r01 to receive rank 8. Job_2 then preserves those upstream ranks when prioritizing unsupported needs, so the incorrect recommendation is downstream of the faulty upstream handoff rather than a separate downstream ranking fault.
